Liczba braków danych to `r n_miss(dane)`, co stanowi `r pct_miss(dane)`% wszystkich danych.

```{r}
dane[] <- lapply(dane, function(x) ifelse(trimws(x) == "", NA, x))
```


```{r}
mcar_test(dane)
```

```{r}
vis_miss(dane, warn_large_data = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gg_miss_var(dane)
```
```{r}
gg_miss_upset(dane)
```

```{r}
gg_miss_fct(dane,fct=Weather_Conditions)
```

```{r}
gg_miss_fct(dane,fct=Road_Surface_Conditions)
```

```{r}
gg_miss_fct(dane,fct=Road_Type)
```
```{r}
gg_miss_span(dane,
             Number_of_Vehicles,
             span_every = 1,
             facet = Weather_Conditions)
```
